info.title: Payhip Universal API
info.description: Manage Payhip coupons and license keys

post.description: Creates a new coupon in Payhip.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

couponType.description: Choose whether the coupon applies to all products, specific products, or specific collections.

code.description: The coupon code customers will enter at checkout.

percentOff.description: Percentage discount to apply when using a percentage-based coupon.

amountOff.description: Fixed amount discount to apply when using an amount-based coupon.

productKey.description: Required when the coupon targets a specific product.

collectionId.description: Required when the coupon targets a specific collection.

usageLimit.description: Maximum number of times the coupon can be redeemed.

minimumPurchaseAmount.description: Minimum purchase amount required before the coupon applies.

startDate.description: Optional start date for the coupon.

endDate.description: Optional end date for the coupon.

notes.description: Internal notes stored with the coupon.

collectionId.description: Target collection identifier when scoped to a collection.

productKey.description: Target product key when scoped to a product.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

put.description: Decreases a Payhip license key usage count.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

licenseKey.description: The Payhip license key whose usage count should be decreased.

buyerEmail.description: The buyer email associated with the license key.

date.description: The Payhip timestamp returned for the license record.

enabled.description: Whether the license key is enabled.

productLink.description: The Payhip product URL associated with the license key.

productName.description: The Payhip product name associated with the license key.

uses.description: The current usage count for the license key.
